explanation: Use the sorted characters of each entire entry as its key. Entries with identical character frequencies share a group. Preserve the original entries and omit singleton groups, as required by this EPI variant.
timeComplexity: O(n + Σ L log(L+1)), where n is entry count and L is an entry length
spaceComplexity: O(n + Σ L) for keys and grouped entries
attribution: JavaScript port of the independently authored EPI Practice C# algorithm; no upstream reference code copied.
